curves.name: Gate charge characteristics
curves.page_reference: p. 5, Typical Characteristics, Gate Charge Characteristics
curves.test_conditions: VDD = 30 V; ID = 0.37 A; Ta = 25 degC; digitized from the typical gate-charge figure

extraction_notes: The supplied public datasheet is WNM6002, Will Semiconductor Ltd., Oct, 2019 - Rev.1.1; the orderable marking is WNM6002-3/TR in SOT-323.
This is an N-channel enhancement MOSFET; all polarity values are reported as positive magnitudes.
The electrical-characteristics heading states Ta = 25 degC unless otherwise noted.

RDS(on) has no typical table column: the published bounds are 1.4 ohm minimum and 2.0 ohm maximum at VGS = 10 V, ID = 0.37 A, and 1.7 ohm minimum and 2.6 ohm maximum at VGS = 4.5 V, ID = 0.20 A. Both bounds are represented as separate rdson_points.
The published capacitance values are CISS = 23.37 pF, COSS = 7.33 pF, and CRSS = 5.2 pF, all typical at VGS = 0 V, VDS = 25 V, and f = 1 MHz; values are converted to farads.
The published breakdown value is BVDSS = 60 V minimum at VGS = 0 V and ID = 250 uA.
The published zero-gate drain current is IDSS = 1 uA maximum at VDS = 60 V and VGS = 0 V. Gate leakage is IGSS = +/-5 uA maximum at VDS = 0 V and VGS = +/-20 V.
The published forward-transconductance value is gFS = 0.42 S minimum at VDS = 15 V and ID = 0.25 A.

The published body-diode forward-voltage bounds are 0.9 V minimum and 1.5 V maximum at VGS = 0 V and IS = 0.3 A; the body_diode scalar uses the 25 degC typical curve read, while the table bounds are retained here.

The published gate-charge values are QG(TOT) = 1.2 nC, QG(TH) = 0.15 nC, QGS = 0.21 nC, and QGD = 0.12 nC at VGS = 10 V, VDD = 30 V, and ID = 0.37 A. The gate-charge curve is included separately as a digitized verification curve.
The switching table publishes td(on) = 7.6 ns, tr = 5.1 ns, td(off) = 24.6 ns, and tf = 10 ns at VDD = 30 V, ID = 0.2 A, VGEN = 10 V, and RG = 10 ohm.

Thermal table values are RthetaJA typical/max = 245/335 degC/W for a 1 square inch FR-4 pad with pulse duration <= 10 s, 325/395 degC/W steady state on that pad, 375/430 degC/W for the minimum-pad pulse condition, 445/535 degC/W for the minimum-pad steady-state condition, and RthetaJC typical/max = 260/300 degC/W steady state.

Additional figures for on-resistance versus current, gate voltage, and junction temperature; threshold voltage versus temperature; single-pulse power; safe operating power; and transient thermal response were inspected but are not required terminal MOSFET identification curves and are not represented by inferred points.
Curve points are direct approximate digitizations from the labeled traces. No vendor SPICE model or vendor SPICE pack was used, and no points were interpolated beyond visible trace readings.
